howto.what_en: Claude can apply its knowledge of the esm Python SDK to help write or modify code for generating protein sequences, predicting structures, inverse folding, and computing protein embeddings, as well as advise on model selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are working directly with the esm Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to complete this partial sequence by filling the masked positions.
